title: A ransomware attack disrupted operations at South Korean conglomerate Kyowon

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A cyberattack on Central Maine Healthcare exposed the personal, medical, and insurance data of about 145,000 patients. Central Maine Healthcare notified patients affected by a data security incident. The organization detected unusual activity on June 1, 2025, secured its systems, and launched an investigation with the help of third-party cybersecurity experts while notifying law enforcement. […]
title: Central Maine Healthcare data breach impacted over 145,000 patients

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: China has told domestic firms to stop using U.S. and Israeli cybersecurity software, citing national security concerns amid rising tech tensions. Reuters reported that China has ordered domestic companies to stop using cybersecurity solutions from more than a dozen U.S. and Israeli firms, citing national security risks. title: China bans U.S. and Israeli cybersecurity software over security concerns
